review.reason: The course silhouette, mapped features, natural single-surface greens, and visible fairway striping are generally well represented. However, added tree crowns crowd the Hole 1 approach between its fairway end and G1.

issues.detail: A tree crown and its shadow sit immediately beside the approach from the central fairway patch toward G1, intruding into that approach corridor.
issues.consequence: The overview makes the approach to G1 appear partly obstructed.
